sources.title: Cocos Island - Orthophoto - 2011
sources.catalogue_license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (DataWA API item); no imagery bytes acquired because over 32 MiB
sources.access_path: Full mosaics in GIS package; GA metadata says 1 km ECW/TIFF tiles and raw imagery may be requested from GA. No request/contact made.
sources.fitness: Potential later source only; 15 cm pixel size and nominal 30 cm horizontal accuracy; low-tide exposure, 8-day collection window, mosaic color balance and alternate-frame replacement limit stable shoreline interpretation. Target frame coverage and exact product rights unverified.

sources.title: Cocos Island - DEM - 2011
sources.catalogue_license: DataWA API says CC BY-NC 4.0; data.gov.au mirror advertises CC BY-SA 4.0 while API license_id is cc-nc; rights unresolved, conservatively restricted
sources.access_path: Catalog ZIP exceeds 32 MiB. Manual says 1 m DEM derived from AAM classified ground/non-ground LiDAR; tiles joined into full-extent TIFF. No pixels acquired.
sources.fitness: Potentially informative independent elevation surface, but same survey/tide window; published guide accuracy is 15 cm vertical and 30 cm horizontal. Product terms and source frame coverage unresolved.

sources.access_path: Separate North Keeling mosaic resource; not acquired.
sources.fitness: Not target-coverage evidence; retained only to document complete campaign inventory and avoid confusing the northern mosaic with the southern-atoll product.
